title: Green Economy and Climate Change Act, 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024)
citation: Green Economy and Climate Change Act, 2024 (Act No. 18 of 2024), assent 20 December 2024
evidence: Section 1: "This Act may be cited as the Green Economy and Climate Change Act, 2024, and shall come into operation on the date that the Minister may appoint by statutory instrument." Date of Assent 20th December, 2024; bracketed date 26th December, 2024. Opened the PDF and https://www.parliament.gov.zm/node/12086 on 2026-11-03. No official page opened states the appointed date.
notes: Climate framework act. The commencement order is titled Green Economy and Climate Change (Commencement) Order, 2025 (SI 67 of 2025); it was found only on ZambiaLII (https://zambialii.org/akn/zm/act/si/2025/67), a private host (SAIPAR), whose date of 2025-10-10 matches the secondary index quoted in the register row but is not read from an official page, so in_force is null. Amended by zm-gecc-amendment-act-2026. Implemented by zm-gecc-carbon-market-regs-2026 (made under s. 46). Row permission requested, so no text is stored. English is the only language of legislation in Zambia and no government translation exists; none was looked for beyond the National Assembly, Ministry and ZambiaLII-independent official pages.

title: Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2010 (Act No. 24 of 2010)
citation: Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2010 (Act No. 24 of 2010), Cap. 417, assent 14 August 2010
evidence: Section 1: "This Act may be cited as the Competition and Consumer Protection Act, 2010, and shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may, by statutory instrument, appoint." Date of Assent 14th August, 2010; bracketed date 16th August, 2010. Opened the PDF and https://www.parliament.gov.zm/node/3351 on 2026-11-03.
notes: Umbrella for environmental claims: s. 47 (false or misleading representations about goods and services) and s. 49 (unfair trading). Section 47 was repealed and replaced by s. 19 of Act No. 21 of 2023 and s. 49(2) amended by s. 21 of that Act (see zm-ccpa-amendment-act-2023). Neither the Act nor the 2023 amendment mentions environmental or green claims. The commencement order was not found on an official page, so in_force is null. The Competition and Consumer Protection (Amendment) Act, 2026 (Act No. 48 of 2026, https://www.parliament.gov.zm/node/13355) changes only the Board's composition and has no entry. Row permission requested, so no text is stored. English is the only language of legislation in Zambia and no government translation exists; none was looked for beyond the National Assembly, Ministry and ZambiaLII-independent official pages.
